pages.text: Once upon a time, in a green forest, there lived a rabbit named Raju.
Raju loved running among the trees and flowers every morning.
One day, he found a small bird that had fallen from its nest.
Raju carefully helped the bird return safely to its home.
From that day on, all the animals called Raju the bravest rabbit in the forest.
Deep inside the forest lived a clever fox named Fifi.
Fifi loved solving problems for her animal friends.
One afternoon, the river bridge broke after a heavy storm.
Fifi gathered wood and helped the animals build a new bridge.
The forest animals celebrated Fifi's clever idea with a grand feast.
An elephant named Ella lived beside a sparkling lake.
Ella always shared water and fruit with every animal.
During a hot summer, the lake began to dry up.
Ella used her strength to dig a new water hole for everyone.
The animals thanked Ella for her kindness and generosity.
A tiny turtle named Timo dreamed of exploring the ocean.
Every day, Timo practiced swimming near the shore.
One day, a strong wave carried him far from home.
A friendly dolphin guided Timo safely back to the beach.
Timo learned that courage and friendship make every journey easier.
Bella the bird loved singing beautiful songs every morning.
Her cheerful melodies filled the forest with happiness.
One day, Bella lost her voice and became very sad.
Her friends encouraged her to rest and regain her strength.
Soon Bella's songs returned, and the forest became joyful once again.
